verdicts.question: implementation
verdicts.evidence: src/GBGCodingTools.jl:42-43 adds a `consolidate` bullet claiming the built-site manuscript is 'a docs round's seeds are planted into' — false. src/CLI/Rounds.jl:214-216 states plainly 'A consistency round seeds one consolidated manuscript; a docs round's corpus is the source tree itself' — it is the CONSISTENCY round (Rounds.jl:149-158) whose seeds go into consolidate()'s manuscript; a docs round's seeds are planted into a disposable copy of source FILES via seed_docs_corpus!/Seed.jl's file_manuscript, an explicitly different, non-rendered manuscript (Seed.jl: 'a docs round's corpus is FILES, not a rendered site').
